name: Hayashi Ruu
source:
2nd year Western Cuisine student.
The scornful youth of the boarding house.
A handsome young man whose always smiling.
But inside he's a hidden S that thinks everybody else is beneath him.
He's [url=/c34029]Karasawa Rei's[/url] younger brother.
When they were young Karasawa was taken in by their mother while he was taken in by their father.
And now they barely interact and have a very bad relationship.
